ITEM 1A. RISK FACTORS

Our business, financial condition, and results of operations could be materially adversely affected by several key risk factors:
We rely on third-party foundry partners, primarily Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC), to manufacture all of our semiconductor wafers.
Any disruption in TSMC's manufacturing capacity, geopolitical conflict in the Taiwan Strait, natural disasters, or export trade sanctions could severely impede our ability to supply our Hopper HGX architecture, Blackwell chips, and Data Center GPUs.
Because we are fabless, we do not own or operate semiconductor fabrication facilities. If TSMC is unable or unwilling to allocate sufficient advanced packaging (CoWoS) and wafer capacity to us, our revenue and gross margins would be harmed.
Furthermore, U.S. government export controls and licensing requirements on high-performance GPUs shipped to China and other designated countries have impacted and may continue to materially reduce our Data Center revenue.
